title: Geometry Dash Music Disc Pack
description: This project adds some GD music discs to the game! these will totally bless your ears
body:
Hi its my first pack and changes 4 discs in the game from underrated game Geometry Dash.                  
( maybe im late but i was bored lol so here i am )                                                            
it adds: Grief, Future Funk, Amethyst and Flamewall. 

You can search it in the creative menu search bar too! ( how cool )

I will update it in the future and comment which song should i change!
